subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V, are sitting in a row facing north. Q is sitting third from the right end. V is sitting third to the left of S. T is sitting to the right of Q and at one of the extreme ends of the row. Only two people sit between U and T. P is not sitting at any extreme end.

Who is sitting second from the right end?
solution:
**Given:**

Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row facing north.

Q is sitting third from the right end.

V is sitting third to the left of S.

T is sitting to the right of Q and at one of the extreme ends of the row.

Only two people sit between U and T.

P is not sitting at any extreme end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37478b072be024da8f6340e93c5369ace55c6c15ca865a2d2631589fc5aa944d.png] 

Find who is sitting second from the right end.

From the right end:

1st from right = T

2nd from right = S

Therefore, **S** is sitting second from the right end.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".**
